checked_sources: Independent arithmetic/symbolic replay: Independent symbolic logit gain and negative Schwarzian differentiation; 776 exact rational nontrivial words of length<=4 over {-1,-1/2,0,1/2,1}, checking left/right endpoint displacement signs where product is strictly <1 or >1; exact 2-cycle and Floquet multiplier 27389/22440, plus analysis of A or B = 1 boundary by strict monotonicity.
correctness.rationale: For x in (0,1) and t in [-1,1], q_t=x[1+t(1-x)] and 1-q_t=(1-x)(1-tx), both bracket factors strictly positive. For G_t=logit circ q_t circ sigmoid, G_t'=1+t^2 x(1-x)/([1+t(1-x)](1-tx))>=1, strict if t nonzero. Any nontrivial word makes G_w-id strictly increasing and its exact extended left/right limits are log A_w and -log B_w (including product zero and log 0=-infinity). Hence exactly one root iff both products strictly <1, with G_w'>1 at root. At a fixed point original-coordinate multiplier equals logit derivative; regular piecewise cycles are locally the same smooth word. Verified the symbolic derivative and Schwarzian S q=-6t^2/q'^2, 776 independent rational endpoint-sign word checks including extreme coefficients, and the exact rational cycle 1/5->17/50->1/5 with multiplier 27389/22440. The finite checks are corroboration only.

evidence: Lemma B.2 applies to every C3 orientation-preserving interval diffeomorphism with strictly negative Schwarzian on a dense open set, a strictly larger class than the polynomial word maps.
Example 4.4 specifically gives q_a and verifies its negative Schwarzian; the chain rule covers arbitrary finite compositions.
The 2019 Rozikov–Usmonov theorem covers repulsion for a special one-cut model; the older and broader Bonifant–Milnor route covers every interior-parameter word.

The endpoint cases |t|=1 fail the closed-interval diffeomorphism condition but have a routine continuous/interior-logit extension; they do not constitute a novel structural theorem.

evidence: Compute S(q_t)=-6t^2/[1+t(1-2x)]^2<0 for nonzero |t|<1; Schwarzian composition preserves strict negativity.
Q_w'(0)=prod_j(1+t_j), Q_w'(1)=prod_j(1-t_j). Hence Bonifant–Milnor B.2 plus elementary endpoint sign/IVT yields unique interior fixed point iff A_w,B_w<1 and derivative >1 at the root.
Their Remark B.5 explicitly identifies the Poincare arclength with the logit coordinate used in the submitted proof; their B.4 establishes strict expansion of logit differences.
For a regular piecewise cycle the return map agrees on its branch neighborhood with a finite word, so the same fixed-point lemma immediately gives repulsion.
At t=+/-1, the submitted identity G_t'=1+t^2 x(1-x)/{[1+t(1-x)](1-tx)}>1 on (0,1) supplies the trivial boundary extension, not a new unknown natural invariant.

Its Appendix B derives S(f∘g)=(Sf∘g)(g')^2+Sg and Lemma B.2 establishes at most three fixed points, repelling middle and strictly attracting endpoints when all three exist.
For any word Q_w, Q_w(0)=0,Q_w(1)=1, Q_w'(0)=A_w, Q_w'(1)=B_w. For |t_j|<1 and a nonzero coefficient S(Q_w)<0 throughout (0,1).
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: By IVT, A_w<1 and B_w<1 force an interior fixed point. Lemma B.2 makes it unique/repelling; conversely any interior fixed forces both boundary multipliers below one. Thus exactly the advertised iff, including order-insensitivity of existence, is a direct specialization of the 2006 general lemma.

originality.rationale: Bonifant–Milnor (2006), Example 4.4, explicitly studies the IDENTICAL q_a(y)=y+a y(1-y) family for |a|<1 and notes strictly negative Schwarzian and cross-ratio expansion; Appendix B Lemma B.1 composition identity and Lemma B.2 already imply the unrestricted word-product iff criterion and repelling uniqueness by substituting the endpoint derivatives A_w and B_w. Piecewise regular cycles are the immediate local-word corollary. t=+/-1 are boundary-degenerate but follow by the elementary exact logit identity; that routine boundary extension does not salvage a distinct scientific result.
residual_risks: The 2006 closed-interval diffeomorphism lemma excludes t=+/-1; this is an explicitly scoped technical distinction, and the all-extreme-coefficient extension is verified separately from the source proof, but is routine and insufficient for new value.
No claim about detailed global chaos or discontinuity-hitting periodic points is covered or assessed; these were expressly outside the submitted final claim.

value.rationale: All-word repulsion and its endpoint-product criterion are direct corollaries of the general negative-Schwarzian three-fixed-point lemma already explicitly applied to q_a in a 2006 primary paper.
